segments.content:
Rekindling the Verdant Years, Chapter 188: A World for Two in the Piano Room

In the evening, Li Luo and the other five gathered together.

The last time the six of them had gathered like this for a meal at Bihai Lanting was three months ago, during the National Day holiday.

What was different today was that after everyone had informed their elders at home, they were all planning to stay the night here.

Li Luo cooked a full table of dishes, eight dishes and one soup, which left him quite exhausted.

In his past life, it was precisely because he didn't want to flip the wok with such high intensity every day that he gave up on the path of being a chef. He never expected that after being reborn, he would still have to cook every day.

But if the ones he was serving were these adorable people before him, it wasn't so hard to accept.

"Delicious!" Qiao Xinyan couldn't help but give a thumbs up in praise after just one bite. "I've been thinking about this flavor ever since I last had it. I feel like it's much more delicious than what my mom makes."

"Ahem... You should only say that here." Li Luo accepted the compliment as a matter of course, but reminded her, "Don't say that to Auntie when you get home."

"I'm not stupid."

The six of them sat around in a circle, and Li Luo raised his chopsticks, being the first to say, "Let's eat."

The meal left them with full stomachs.

Perhaps because the desensitization training of playing basketball together in the afternoon had been somewhat effective, Zhao Rongjun wasn't as reserved as before while eating.

If it were in the past, with so many girls around, he would probably only dare to take food from the two or three dishes in front of him.

Today, his courage was commendable; he even dared to stand up to get a dish from the opposite side of the table.

Of course, Li Luo had intentionally placed the two dishes this fellow liked most on the other end, and it seemed to be having a good effect now.

If he could gradually become more cheerful and composed in front of Ying Chanxi and the others, then in the future, when facing ordinary girls, he at least wouldn't appear timid.

For the sake of his good brother's future happiness, Li Luo had certainly put in a lot of effort.

After dinner, as the hosts living here, Ying Chanxi and Xu Youyu obediently began to clear the table, wash the dishes in the kitchen, and clean up.

Li Luo arranged for Qiao Xinyan and Zhao Rongjun to go watch TV on the sofa.

He had originally wanted to pull Yan Zhusheng over to the sofa as well, but Yan Zhusheng shook her head and walked straight into the piano room. She then waved at Li Luo, signaling for him to come in too.

Thus, while Ying Chanxi and Xu Youyu were washing dishes and Zhao Rongjun and Qiao Xinyan were watching TV, the two of them went into the piano room.

"Why'd you call me in here?"

"To play guitar." Yan Zhusheng said, pulling the guitar from the corner into her arms. "I promised to teach you how to practice the guitar, so we should practice whenever there's time."

"You're quite a conscientious teacher, then."

"I'm glad you know." Yan Zhusheng nodded, demonstrated a few rather impressive little tricks, then stuffed the guitar into Li Luo's arms for him to try.

For Li Luo, some basic guitar techniques were already well-mastered, but he had never been exposed to the more advanced stuff, as Yan Zhusheng hadn't taught him before.

Only when Xie Shuchen was occasionally showing off in the rock club did Li Luo get to see some little techniques like slides, sweeps, and harmonics.

For a high school rock club, these things were more or less optional in terms of effect. After all, most students were just listening for the atmosphere and couldn't distinguish the differences at all.

But for a solo performance, the subtle differences were numerous.

There were even people who could use the guitar as a percussion instrument, making use of the guitar's wooden body to tap and play at the same time, creating a drum-like rhythm that would instantly elevate the audio-visual experience.

Now that the New Year's Gala was over, the rock club had no more activities this year, which was why Yan Zhusheng was now planning to teach Li Luo more advanced things.

"That's not right." Yan Zhusheng observed his movements seriously, then walked behind Li Luo, leaned over, and held his hands. "Like this, look. Feel this vibration, then smooth it out instantly, versus smoothing it out slowly. The sound effect is completely different."

Once it came to such advanced techniques, relying solely on the Mind Palace's spiritual possession was no longer enough.

After all, spiritual possession was just a mimicry of the form. When it really came down to needing to carefully feel the touch of the strings and distinguish the sound effects, the limitations of spiritual possession were exposed.

But even so, Li Luo's learning progress was still not slow.

However, the people outside didn't give them too much time to practice.

After about twenty minutes, a voice could be faintly heard from the living room. "Huh? How come it's just the two of you watching TV?" Ying Chanxi asked strangely, flicking the water off her hands. "Where are Li Luo and Zhusheng?"

"They went into the piano room," Qiao Xinyan said, pointing in the direction of the piano room.

As soon as she said this, Ying Chanxi's expression changed slightly, then quickly returned to normal. She just nodded and slowly walked to the door of the piano room.

The moment she pushed the door open, she happened to see the scene of Yan Zhusheng leaning over and personally teaching Li Luo how to play the guitar, and she froze instantly.

Because from her angle, Yan Zhusheng's posture looked off, no matter how she looked at it... it was as if she were standing behind Li Luo, leaning over to kiss his cheek.

Yan Zhusheng, however, had a calm expression. Seeing Ying Chanxi open the door and come in, she straightened up and asked, "Xixi, is something wrong?"

"I... um... that... you guys..." Ying Chanxi's mind was a bit muddled, and she stammered, unable to speak clearly.

It wasn't until she clearly saw the guitar in Li Luo's arms that she asked with a sliver of hope, "...What are you two doing?"

"Oh, I'm teaching him guitar." Yan Zhusheng took Ying Chanxi's hand, led her to sit on the piano bench, and then clapped her hands at Li Luo, saying, "Alright, try it with the technique I just taught you."

"Okay." Li Luo didn't notice Ying Chanxi's strange behavior. He just swept his fingers across the strings and tried to apply the techniques he had just learned to the song "The Light Chaser".

After simply singing half the song, once the chorus ended, Li Luo swept through a final chord to end the performance, then raised an eyebrow at Yan Zhusheng. "How was it? Not bad, right?"

"Mhm," Yan Zhusheng nodded. "But there are still some flaws. You need to practice more in the future."

"Also, the mood of 'The Light Chaser' is more soothing and subtle, so you don't really need that many techniques. Adding too many will make the whole song feel heavy."

"So for songs like this, you just need to add a little embellishment. But for more rock-oriented songs, you can try more combinations of techniques, and the listening experience will be much richer."

Only on topics related to music could Yan Zhusheng say so much at once.

At this point, Ying Chanxi also came to her senses. She had probably really seen it wrong just now.

How could a girl with Yan Zhusheng's personality possibly take the initiative to kiss Li Luo?

Thinking of this, Ying Chanxi's mood instantly went from stormy to partly cloudy. She happily hugged Yan Zhusheng's arm and said, "You two, stop practicing for now. It's rare for us to get together, let's go out and play cards together!"

"Oh." Yan Zhusheng nodded and got up to walk out with Ying Chanxi. She didn't forget to remind Li Luo, "Remember to practice more often. You can also play for Xixi and Senior Sister when you get home."

"That's a good idea," Ying Chanxi agreed. "Did you hear that? Zhusheng has spoken."

"I know." Li Luo put the guitar back in its case in the corner, got up, and followed them out of the piano room to the living room.

Xu Youyu had already taken out two decks of playing cards. After picking out the two big jokers and one little joker, she shuffled them together.

Seeing Li Luo and the other two come out of the piano room, Xu Youyu started dealing cards with great enthusiasm. "Let's play Old Maid, okay? There's a penalty for the loser!"

"Why aren't we playing Fight the Landlord?" Li Luo frowned. Recalling the tragic picnic during the afternoon of the New Year's Gala, he instinctively took half a step back.

For games like Fight the Landlord that required the brainpower to remember cards, Li Luo was basically unlikely to lose, unless his hand was truly terrible.

But for a game like Old Maid that relied purely on luck, he had no advantage whatsoever.

Hearing his words, Xu Youyu just chuckled. "What, are you scared?"

Saying that, she held up the lipstick in her hand and said with a grin, "You're not escaping today."

Li Luo gave an awkward smile, feeling that something was amiss.

But Xu Youyu was already shouting commands, "Xixi! Zhusheng! Hold him down!"

"Where do you think you're going?" Ying Chanxi grabbed one of his arms and huffed, "We let you win so many times last night, let's continue today."

"I never said I was going to run. Isn't this a bit unnecessary?" Li Luo looked at Ying Chanxi, then at Yan Zhusheng who had grabbed him without hesitation, and was instantly speechless. "Yan Zhusheng, you weren't even here last night, why are you listening to them?"

Yan Zhusheng blinked, her grip on his arm only tightening. "I'm listening to Senior Sister."

(End of Chapter)
